decision_rationale: The paper presents a pretrained multimodal framework with zero-shot transfer and broad ST pretraining, which is foundation-model-like. However, the described objectives are contrastive/alignment and prediction, with no explicit generative mechanism.
evidence_snippet: "pretrain ST-Align on 1.3 million spot-level image-gene pairs"; "multi-level contrastive objectives"; "image-to-gene prediction"; "frozen encoders" in the baselines section
